subject: Re: KYC / AML evidence needed for Ariba registration — Order Form clause exception
messages:
From: ComplianceOps <procure@acmehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: maya.patel@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration - outstanding evidence

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We’re almost done with the Ariba enrollment but procurement needs final KYC/AML evidence before we can activate Redwood in our vendor portal. Attached is the registration checklist from our Ariba team (see acme_kyc_packet_v1.pdf). Key asks they surfaced:

- Completed beneficial ownership table (we can provide a template)
- Copy of SOC 2 or equivalent security attestation (PDF)
- Confirmation that Redwood will not store PII beyond transaction logs (we need an explicit clause)

One wrinkle: our legal team flagged the Order Form indemnity schedule; they asked whether Redwood can accept a limited carve for regulated PHI-related exposures when processing under a covered customer flow. That’s a high-level ask — I can loop legal if helpful.

Can you confirm when we can provide the ownership table and whether you can accept the one-sentence data retention guarantee they requested? Procurement needs this by COB Friday to meet our vendor go-live.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
ComplianceOps — AcmeHealth
procure@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_kyc_packet_v1.pdf (PDF, 360KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: ComplianceOps <procure@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration - outstanding evidence

Maya — thanks for the checklist and the heads up on legal’s concern. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

- Beneficial ownership: we have a template — Mateo, can you populate the BO table for Acme with SAFE entities and our VC cap table? I’ll attach once ready.
- SOC2: we’ll provide the latest Type II report (redacted) via secure link; Laura, can you confirm standard redactions?
- Data retention clause: we can provide a concise statement confirming we do not persist customer PII beyond what’s necessary for transaction logs and audit (can be a short sentence in the Order Form).

On the indemnity carve: our legal team generally resists carveouts in the MSA because it creates precedent across the book. That said, for customers in regulated healthcare we have an established alternative — we can route PHI processing through a dedicated private deployment (Private) with specific SLA and insurance levels. If Acme needs a limited contractual carve, we’ll need legal to weigh in and provide a redline to the Order Form.

My ask: Laura, Markus — can you review Acme’s requested language and propose either (A) accept language for the Order Form that is narrow and timeboxed or (B) propose standard private-deployment verbiage we can offer as a compliance pathway? Procurement needs an answer by COB Friday (2027-09-17).

Maya — I’ll follow up with the BO table and SOC2 link by EOD. If it helps, we can schedule a 30 min quick sync with legal this afternoon.

Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Attachment: none
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration - outstanding evidence

Team — summarized review and recommended redline approach below. I’ve attached a tracked-redline to the Order Form (redline_orderform_ACME_20270914.docx) with two paths:

Path 1 — Narrow contractual concession (preferred if sales needs a signed Order Form quickly):
- Add a single sentence under Data Processing / Limitations of Liability: "Notwithstanding the foregoing, with respect to Processing of Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined under HIPAA, the parties agree that Redwood’s liability for PHI-related claims shall be subject to the limits set forth in Section X, provided Customer elects Redwood Private deployment and implements the agreed technical controls."
- Timebox: concession applies only to the initial 12 months from go-live, after which the standard MSA limits resume.
- Requires: confirmation that Acme will select Private deployment or accept a scoped SLA and audit right.

Path 2 — Standard alternative (lower risk to Redwood):
- Do not alter indemnity; instead attach a compliance addendum and offer Private deployment pricing and an SOC2 + data processing addendum with mandatory controls.

For the data retention sentence Acme requested, proposed language: "Redwood retains customer personal data only for the minimum period necessary to provide the Services and to comply with legal obligations; Redwood does not use Customer PII for model training, and persistent storage of PII beyond transaction and audit logs will not occur except as required for legal or regulatory reasons."

Next steps: Jonas, propose that we share Path 1 redline (limited concession) as a commercial compromise and attach the Private deployment option and SOC2 evidence. Mateo — please confirm the ownership table and upload the SOC2 redacted PDF to the secure folder. I’ve also included a short note for procurement to explain the timebox and controls.

Attachment: redline_orderform_ACME_20270914.docx (Word, tracked changes)

- Laura Bennett
General Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: ComplianceOps <procure@acmehealth.com>, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-09-14T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration - outstanding evidence

Jonas / Laura —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the two-path approach — that helps. Procurement is willing to accept Path 1 (narrow concession) provided the timebox and Private deployment fallback are explicit. Legal has one small tweak to the suggested data retention sentence to call out the data categories (PII, PHI, metadata) — I’ve attached a short note and signed acceptance of the DocuSign envelope once you populate the Order Form.

We’ll upload the completed beneficial ownership table to your secure link by EOD tomorrow and have the DocuSign team on standby. Can you send the DocuSign link once the Order Form is updated with the agreed Path 1 language?

Maya
Maya Patel
ComplianceOps — AcmeHealth
